titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Study and daily work: Listening comprehension

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Study and daily work. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

texto: Listening at work and school: train your ear to catch deadlines and commitments. When you hear «ฉันต้องส่งการบ้านวันนี้», identify the modal verb of obligation «ต้อง» [dtɔ̂ɔng, falling tone], the noun «การบ้าน» [kaan-bâan] and the final time marker «วันนี้» [wan-níi, today]. Recognising these elements avoids missing due dates.
